instruction: Grab the medium adult shoe off the table and drop it on the mat

source.instruction: Grab the medium adult shoe off the table and drop it on the mat

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the shoe, which was at x = +20 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Point the right gripper downwards, rotate yaw, and move over the shoe around (20, -3, 94).
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-10, +16, +0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -3, 94) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the right arm slightly towards the shoe to z=89.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -5) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +15 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -3, 89) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the gripper down to z=79 around the shoe body to prepare for grasping.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, +0, -10) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +6 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -3, 79) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw slightly to align with the shoe contours and close the gripper.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -3, 79) opening 0.75; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the shoe up to z=86 to clear the table surface.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (20, -3, 86) opening 0.77; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move the right arm up to z=89.5 and horizontally to (0, -8) above the blue mat.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-20, -5, +3) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (0, -8, 90) opening 0.77; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw by 90 degrees to align the shoe horizontally with the mat.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips stayed in place, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +5 cm (vertical) from the shoe

frames.label: turn 8
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (0, -8, 89) opening 0.77; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the right gripper down to table level (z=79.5) and open the gripper to place it.
